title: Galaxy split row
description: A half-and-half row on a 12-column grid: media on one side (a square video, a 16:9 image, a small centred artwork or a built card) and, vertically centred on the other, an uppercase eyebrow, a big tightly tracked heading, a lead and a white pill button whose arrow slides on hover. Phones stack media first. An optional row of link columns with left rules and nudging chevrons runs underneath.
notes: mediaShape: square (1:1, fills the half), wide (16:9, fills the half), art (a ~300px centred tile), card (your own element, up to 560px, centred)
narrowText takes the text down to five columns, leaving a wider gap by the media
reads --galaxy-stretch to narrow the heading when the galaxy theme is on
